courseDetails.title: AI-Powered SOC Analyst Bootcamp: AI Security Operations
courseDetails.shortDescription: Master SOC Analysis with AI: Detect Threats, Investigate Incidents, Automate Workflows & Build AI Security Assistants
courseDetails.longDescription:
“This course contains the use of artificial intelligence”

Step into the future of cybersecurity with AI-Powered SOC Analyst Bootcamp, a practical, hands-on course designed to teach you how Artificial Intelligence is transforming modern Security Operations Centers (SOCs).

Cybersecurity teams today face an overwhelming volume of security alerts, logs, phishing attempts, suspicious activity, vulnerabilities, and potential incidents. Traditional manual investigation methods can be slow and resource-intensive. Modern SOC analysts are increasingly using Generative AI and AI-assisted workflows to analyze information faster, reduce repetitive work, improve investigations, and make better security decisions.

In this course, you'll learn how to combine essential SOC Analyst skills with powerful AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot. You'll discover how AI can act as a security copilot—helping you analyze logs, investigate alerts, research threats, correlate indicators, document incidents, build playbooks, and accelerate common SOC workflows.

The course begins with the foundations of Security Operations. You'll learn how a SOC works, understand the responsibilities of Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 SOC Analysts, explore the security monitoring lifecycle, and understand how analysts move from an incoming alert to investigation and incident response.

You'll then build a strong foundation in security logs and event analysis. You'll work with concepts involving Windows Event Logs, Linux authentication logs, firewall logs, DNS logs, web server logs, authentication events, and cloud audit logs. You'll learn how analysts identify suspicious patterns and correlate events across different data sources.

You'll also explore SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) fundamentals, including log collection, correlation rules, alert generation, dashboards, and security monitoring. The course introduces major SIEM technologies such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic Security, and IBM QRadar, giving you the foundational knowledge needed to understand how enterprise security monitoring environments operate.

From there, you'll move into AI-assisted security investigations.

You'll learn how to use AI to analyze large collections of security events, identify failed login patterns, suspicious authentication activity, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and other indicators of compromise. You'll also learn how to design effective security prompts that provide AI systems with the right context while maintaining appropriate human oversight.

A major part of the course focuses on phishing investigation. You'll examine concepts including email headers, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, suspicious URLs, attachments, sender behavior, and social-engineering indicators. You'll use AI to help organize evidence, summarize suspicious emails, and develop structured risk assessments.

You'll then explore Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting. You'll learn about Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), CVEs, malware families, threat actors, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework. You'll discover how AI can accelerate threat research, generate hunting hypotheses, correlate evidence, organize investigation timelines, and assist analysts during complex investigations.

The course also takes you through a complete AI-assisted incident investigation workflow. You'll learn how analysts perform alert validation, root-cause analysis, timeline reconstruction, user activity analysis, system-impact assessment, containment, eradication, recovery, and lessons learned.

You'll put these skills into practice through a ransomware investigation project, where you'll approach the incident as a SOC analyst and use AI as an investigation assistant.

But investigating incidents is only part of the job.

Modern security teams must also communicate their findings effectively. You'll learn how AI can assist with incident documentation, technical reports, executive summaries, evidence organization, incident timelines, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping. You'll build an AI-assisted Incident Report Generator capable of transforming investigation findings into structured security documentation.

You'll also learn how to build reusable AI-powered Incident Response Playbooks. These playbooks can help analysts standardize investigation procedures, decision points, response actions, documentation requirements, and escalation processes.

One of the most exciting sections of the course focuses on building your own AI SOC Analyst Assistant.

You'll learn how to design an AI assistant around real SOC workflows using prompt engineering, structured investigation templates, knowledge bases, reusable prompts, and security procedures. Instead of simply asking an AI chatbot random cybersecurity questions, you'll learn how to design a structured assistant that supports repeatable SOC activities.

You'll then take the concept further by exploring Multi-Agent AI Security Operations. You'll design specialized AI roles such as a Tier 1 AI Analyst, Threat Hunter Agent, Malware Analyst Agent, Incident Commander Agent, Report Writer Agent, and Executive Briefing Agent. You'll explore how specialized agents can collaborate across different stages of a security investigation.

The course also addresses one of the most important topics surrounding enterprise AI adoption: AI Governance and Security.

You'll learn about data privacy, secure prompting, AI policies, AI risk management, compliance, sensitive-data handling, human oversight, and responsible AI usage. You'll understand why AI-generated security analysis should be validated rather than blindly trusted and why human-in-the-loop decision making remains essential in security operations.

Finally, you'll learn how organizations measure SOC effectiveness using metrics such as Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR), false-positive rates, alert fatigue, detection quality, and AI performance metrics. You'll also explore emerging concepts such as Agentic SOCs, autonomous detection, AI security platforms, and the future of AI-powered cyber defense.

Throughout the course, you won't just learn theory. You'll complete hands-on projects and practical investigations designed to simulate the types of tasks performed by real SOC and Blue Team professionals.

By the end of the bootcamp, you'll have built a portfolio that can include an AI SOC Analyst Assistant, AI-powered log analysis workflows, phishing investigation toolkit, threat-hunting prompt library, automated incident report generator, AI incident-response playbooks, and a Multi-Agent AI SOC Team.

Whether you're an aspiring SOC Analyst, cybersecurity student, IT professional, Blue Team practitioner, Incident Responder, or an experienced security professional interested in Generative AI, this course will help you understand how to combine traditional cybersecurity skills with modern AI capabilities.

The goal isn't to replace the security analyst with AI. It's to teach you how to become an AI-enabled SOC Analyst—someone who understands cybersecurity fundamentals, knows how to investigate threats, and can use AI responsibly to work faster, smarter, and more effectively in the modern Security Operations Center.

SMART Goals Parenting breaks these (and other) abstract desires down into their basic foundational components that allow you and your child to achieve happiness, connection, trust and respect... repeatedly.


SMART Goals Parenting's objective is to provide you with the knowledge and tools to cultivate your desired relationship with your child while also preparing your child for being able to one day cultivate happiness and success for him/herself.

Yetkinlik Bazlı Davranışsal Mülakatlarda Ustalaşmak

Kurs Açıklaması

Doğru yeteneği işe almak, yüksek performanslı bir organizasyon kurmanın en kritik unsurlarından biridir. Yetkinlik bazlı davranışsal mülakatlar; işe alım yöneticilerinin, işe alım uzmanlarının ve İK profesyonellerinin adayları geçmiş deneyimlere ve kanıtlanmış becerilere odaklanarak daha etkin biçimde değerlendirmesini sağlar.

Bu kurs, yapılandırılmış ve yetkinlik odaklı mülakatlar yürütmeniz için gereken bilgi, teknik ve araçları size kazandırmak üzere tasarlanmıştır — ve her birinin sonunda daha iyi işe alım kararları çıkar.

Pratik vaka çalışmaları, gerçek hayat örnekleri ve mülakat simülasyonları aracılığıyla; temel yetkinlikleri nasıl belirleyeceğinizi, davranışsal mülakat sorularını nasıl yapılandıracağınızı ve aday yanıtlarını puanlama sistemiyle nasıl değerlendireceğinizi öğreneceksiniz.

Ne Öğreneceksiniz?

Yetkinlik Bazlı Mülakatların Temelleri — Davranışsal mülakat ilkelerini ve bunların işe alım doğruluğunu nasıl artırdığını kavrayın.

Yetkinlik Modeli Geliştirme — Farklı roller için temel yetkinlikleri nasıl tanımlayacağınızı ve bunları işe alım sürecine nasıl entegre edeceğinizi öğrenin.

Etkili Davranışsal Sorular Tasarlama — STAR (Durum, Görev, Eylem, Sonuç) yöntemini ve diğer yapılandırılmış teknikleri uygulayın.

Adayları Nesnel Değerlendirme — Yetkinlik bazlı puanlama rubriklerini hayata geçirin ve seçim sürecindeki önyargıyı minimize edin.

Yaygın Mülakat Hatalarından Kaçınma — Zayıf işe alım kararlarına yol açan önyargıları, tuzakları ve etkisiz soru yöntemlerini fark edin.

Veriyle Desteklenen İşe Alım Kararları — Yetkinlik çerçeveleri, değerlendirme ızgaraları ve mülakat puan kartlarından yararlanarak daha isabetli kararlar alın.

Kurs Programı

1. Yetkinlik Bazlı Mülakata Giriş

  • Modern işe alımda davranışsal ve yetkinlik bazlı mülakatların rolü

  • Teknik ve sosyal yetkinlikleri birbirinden ayırt etmek

  • Farklı roller için yetkinlik modellerini özelleştirmek

3. Etkili Davranışsal Mülakat Soruları Hazırlama

  • Açık uçlu, davranışsal sorular yazmak

  • Aday yanıtlarını yapılandırmak için STAR yöntemini kullanmak

  • Yetkinlik bazlı sorularda yapılan yaygın hatalar

4. Mülakat Süreci: Yapılandırma ve Yönetme

  • Mülakatları planlama ve yapılandırmada en iyi uygulamalar

  • Yetkinlik bazlı yaklaşımla panel mülakatı yürütme

  • İşe alım sürecinde adalet ve tutarlılığı sağlama

5. Yetkinlik Bazlı Aday Değerlendirme ve Karar Alma

  • Yetkinlik değerlendirmeleri için puanlama matrisleri tasarlama

  • Yapılandırılmış karar alma için mülakat puan kartlarını kullanma

  • Aday değerlendirmelerinde bilinçdışı önyargıyı önleme

6. Yetkinlik Bazlı Mülakatla İşe Alım Başarısını Artırma

  • Yetkinlik bazlı seçim kullanan şirketlerin vaka çalışmaları

  • Şirketinizde davranışsal mülakat eğitimini hayata geçirme

  • Yapılandırılmış işe alımın yetenek kazanımına etkisini ölçme

Bu Kurs Kime Göre?

Sektör Uzmanlarından Öğrenin — Deneyimli İK liderlerinin ve işe alım uzmanlarının içgörülerinden yararlanın.

İşe alım doğruluğunuzu artırın, çalışan devrini azaltın — davranışsal ve yetkinlik bazlı mülakatı gerçek anlamda öğrenin.

Bu kurs yapay zeka destekli içerikler barındırmakta olup en güncel sektör uygulamalarını yansıtmaktadır.

Hemen kaydolun ve bugünden itibaren yapılandırılmış, etkili mülakatlar gerçekleştirin!

Trendjacking 101: Turn Viral Moments Into Brand Growth is a practical course designed to help marketers, creators, entrepreneurs, and communication professionals discover emerging trends, respond quickly, and create timely content without damaging brand trust.

Trendjacking is the practice of connecting a brand, message, product, or idea to a conversation that is already gaining attention. When done well, it can increase social media reach, engagement, brand awareness, website traffic, and leads. When done poorly, it can appear forced, insensitive, irrelevant, or opportunistic. This course teaches you how to participate strategically and responsibly.

You will begin by learning what trendjacking means and how it differs from newsjacking, meme marketing, real-time marketing, and general trend participation. You will study the life cycle of online trends, including how they emerge, grow, reach saturation, and decline. You will also analyze examples of brands that joined viral moments successfully and brands that created negative reactions.

The trend-discovery section shows you how to monitor social media conversations, search behavior, creators, communities, industry publications, and cultural events. You will build a repeatable trend-monitoring system that helps you identify opportunities before they become overcrowded.

You will then learn how to evaluate brand fit. The course provides practical criteria for assessing audience relevance, timing, saturation, originality, business value, and potential risk. You will also learn when ignoring a trend is the strongest brand decision.

The rapid-content section teaches you how to transform trends into original hooks, captions, posts, short videos, graphics, and campaign concepts. You will learn how to adapt a timely idea across platforms while maintaining your brand voice and avoiding imitation.

Because speed can create mistakes, the course includes a strong focus on brand safety. You will learn how to check context, avoid harmful or sensitive topics, evaluate copyright and attribution, and create an approval process for higher-risk content.

You will also explore publishing and amplification strategies involving timing, keywords, hashtags, mentions, community engagement, and creator partnerships. These methods can help trend-based content become part of a larger conversation.

The real-time operations section explains how teams can create templates, define roles, establish approval workflows, and balance scheduled content with reactive opportunities.

Finally, you will measure reach, engagement velocity, brand sentiment, leads, conversions, and campaign value. Your capstone project is a complete trendjacking playbook containing monitoring tools, evaluation criteria, brand-safety rules, rapid-content templates, and three simulated campaigns.

By the end of the course, you will be prepared to turn timely cultural moments into relevant, responsible, and measurable brand growth.

Une vie épanouissante ne se construit pas uniquement autour de grands objectifs lointains.

Elle se construit aussi à travers une accumulation de moments que tu as réellement envie de vivre.

Ce cours t’invite donc à réfléchir à ce qui te procure de l’enthousiasme, de la curiosité, du plaisir ou un sentiment de liberté, puis à chercher comment créer davantage de place pour ces expériences dans ton quotidien.

Imagine te lever en sachant mieux quoi faire parce que tes actions correspondent davantage à ton état du moment. Imagine avancer avec plus de fluidité parce que tu comprends mieux comment utiliser ton énergie plutôt que de lutter constamment contre elle.
